newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises at fixing but IPB falls again.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises at fixing but IPB falls again.

text.p: Czech major issues boosted the PX50 index at Tuesday's fixing but IPB, the third most heavily weighted banking issue, continued to slide in the wake of sharply lower first half profit figures.
IPB had posted strong gains at the end of last week following an announcement that Nomura would take a 36 percent state-held stake in the bank.
IPB dropped seven crowns, 2.7 perecnt, to 248.

The largest issue on the PX50, SPT Telecom which accounts for 19.7 percent of index capitalisation, rose 25 crowns to 3,740. SPT will release its first half results on Wednesday morning at around 0800 GMT.
